ddf62630: Quit if the unprocessed portion of the text (Y) has been exhausted or if the pseudo-variable DIC("S") is defined and the X-criteria (value to be searched) is not found in the remainder of the input string (YS).

486a650a: Write the portion of the unprocessed input string (YS) starting from the location of X up to the end of the string, but only if the current record is not being edited (DB(DQ) is undefined). Then, set X to the first word of the unprocessed input string.

6dc75443: If the validation string (DV) contains 'P', perform a lookup on the input string (DU) using the file specified in the 'U_' prefix, with the screen defined by DIC("S") if specified. The lookup is performed in either the 'NEW' or 'MODIFY' mode depending on whether the current record is being edited (DB(DQ)). If 'L' is present in DV, set the LAYGO parameter to the second piece of the 'P' component. If '*' is not present in DV, perform the lookup and set X to the internal entry number of the selected entry. Set DIC to the input variable (DIE) and quit if the user entered an up-arrow.

45315784: If DV does not contain 'N', branch to the 'V' label. Otherwise, perform data validation (subroutine D). If the length of the decimal portion of X exceeds 24 characters, kill X and branch to the 'Z' label.
